messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — org=stratus-edge severity=high metric=qps spike detected (6x) — paging #oncall
sara_oncall: grabbing it. seeing 5xx? or 429s? give me a quick screenshot of the error lines
jamie-cs: customers reporting 429s and degraded UX, several support tickets coming in :exclamation:
miguel-sre: prometheus shows org.stratus-edge.token_rate_limit.errors(5m)=18% and p50 latency up 200ms. backend queue backing up.
sara_oncall: confirmed 429s from throttle path. looks like per-org rate limiter hit. current config: 100 req/min org default, burst 200
neha-sre: can we do an emergency per-org override while we triage? temporary bump + disable heavy features (rerank) to ease load
alex-platform: we have an admin override endpoint. I can run if we decide. recommends: increase to 500 req/min, burst 800 for 30m and disable rerank-v2 for that org
sara_oncall: sounds good. who will execute? give me the exact command
alex-platform: using internal CLI:

```
# grant temporary rate override (expires in 30m)
redwood-admin orgs override-rate --org stratus-edge --rate 500 --burst 800 --ttl 30m
# disable feature flag for rerank
redwood-admin ff toggle --org stratus-edge --flag rerank-v2 --state off
```

(or use the internal API)

```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/orgs/stratus-edge/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rate_per_min":500,"burst":800,"ttl_minutes":30,"note":"emergency spike mitigation"}'
```

miguel-sre: i'll monitor infra while alex runs it. if latency keeps rising we fallback to org-level shaping (throttle embeddings/generation) or org circuit-breaker
alex-platform: running the CLI now... :hammer_and_wrench:
deploy-bot: override job queued (job id: ov-20260317-91) by alex-platform
alex-platform: override applied. feature flag rerank-v2 set to off. TTL=30m. docs: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/org-overrides
sara_oncall: confirming metrics — error rate dropping. p50 latency back down ~120ms. 429s reduced dramatically
jamie-cs: informing customers: posting to affected tickets and creating an incident update. cc @customer-ops
neha-sre: keep monitoring for 15m, if we see >10% errors we may need to extend or do quota partitioning
miguel-sre: infra note: GPUs at 75% for serving, redis connection pool ok. no database saturation seen
sara_oncall: action items: 1) keep override in place and monitor 2) postmortem and root-cause triage 3) evaluate adaptive shaper to avoid manual overrides 4) follow up with customer about expected behavior
alex-platform: created a short-lived runbook entry and linked to the incident channel. I'll roll back flag + override at TTL expiry unless we extend
sara_oncall: handing off to neha for overnight watch. neha, you take it? :eyes:
neha-sre: taking handoff. will watch dashboards and coordinate with CS if anything re-escalates. will extend TTL if spike persists
jamie-cs: noted. writing summary for support tickets and sending customer update template
miguel-sre: reminder: create an eval to reproduce the traffic pattern and run a load test against rate limiter next week
sara_oncall: thanks team. will file full postmortem template and tag eng-runtime + product. closing onprimary pager for now :white_check_mark:
